digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center reconciler transport (jira_datacenter adapter)
propositions: Build the Jira Data Center transport on the pycontribs/jira library, confined to an opt-in [jira-datacenter] extra and imported lazily so import rebar stays dependency-free and a missing extra raises a clear install-naming error.
Authenticate via a Personal Access Token read env-only from JIRA_PAT passed as token_auth, with url/project from typed config, failing loudly on malformed config rather than degrading to env-only.
Every transport method must return raw payload shapes rebar's existing mappers consume rather than jira.Issue objects, verified against the shared _jira_shape_contract used by the Cloud transport.

Map retry/timeout/error handling onto rebar's transport contract: retry transient faults with the acli_rest 2s/5s backoff (including builtin TimeoutError), never retry HTTP errors, and raise BackendAssigneeNotFoundError for unknown assignees.
Register the DC backend via a self-registration import in adapters/__init__.py so select_backend('jira-datacenter') resolves, raising BackendRegistryError (not KeyError) when absent.

Add DC connection settings to _config_schema.py: reject non-https base_url unless allow_insecure=true, never disable TLS verification (options['verify']), support ca_bundle, and configure resolved_statuses defaulting to Resolved/Done/Cancelled.
